turns.user_utterance: My card's frozen, what can I do?
turns.assistant_response: Sorry to hear that—when you say “frozen,” do you mean the card is blocked due to suspicious activity, or is it because you entered the wrong PIN and it got locked? Also, are you trying to use it in a shop/online or at an ATM?

turns.user_utterance: I think it’s because I entered the wrong PIN a few times and now it won’t work, especially at the ATM.
turns.assistant_response: Got it—if you entered the wrong PIN a few times, your PIN is likely blocked. You’ll need to unblock/reset your PIN to use the card again (including at the ATM). Are you able to access the app to change your PIN, or do you need help getting your PIN reset another way?
